scope.change: commit b4fc1de (+ the S1 fix commit)

checksBeforeReview.fullSuite: 1194/1195 per version; the only failure was the pre-commit release-pin check, which passes after the commit (10/10)

findings.claim: The window fill reads a trimmed visible row through a locator recorded in decoded-text bytes, so a row holding bytes that are not valid UTF-8 cannot be read back; the hole makes historyWindow throw where the whole-file implementation returned the rows.
findings.reproduced: yes - 0x80 line + normal line + 2049 tombstones: historyWindow('outcomes', 10) threw ValidationError, baseline returned both rows
findings.fix: Locators record the file's own byte range: #walkArchiveLines hands out each line's raw byte length, and the scan accumulates offsets and lengths from it (fault bytes stay the decoded length). Regression test added in test/cold-archive-streaming-scan.test.mjs (fails before the fix, passes after). Rejected the suggested streaming fallback: recording the bytes the locator can read back is smaller and removes the root cause instead of adding a second row-reading protocol.
findings.verification: test/cold-archive-streaming-scan.test.mjs 4/4 (the new case fails on the unfixed tree); 12 focused files 114/114; 80k end-to-end peak RSS 286-306 MB and knowledge scan 532-541 ms, unchanged from the pre-fix candidate
